title: skills and spec text: app skills on `ask`, the tool allow-set, and what a trigger condition can read
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Source: topic objectstack-ai/cloud#4961.
Grading: area:cloud · Task · p3 · reach: n/a · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：把发布给应用作者的技能文档和协议说明改成实情：应用技能在应用内问数助手里怎么生效、哪些工具拿不到、触发条件能读哪些字段，以及这些字段来自界面、不能当权限用。
- 需要你做的：这次改动含受管面（技能文档、ADR 指针），PR 要你手工合并。

## What
1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`: a package skill with `surface` `ask` / `both` is loaded for the app the user is in (the `build` side is not served while in-app build is closed); tools outside the allow-set are dropped with a diagnostic; the context fields a condition can read (`appName`, `objectName`, `recordId`, `selectionKind`, and `userRole`). All of them are client-sent: a `triggerConditions` entry on any of them, `userRole` included, is routing, never access control, and the turn's tools still run under the caller's own permissions (scope addition, comment 7152100136, from the L2 on objectstack-ai/cloud#4985).
2. `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts`: the `triggerConditions` describe adds that the fields are reported by the client and are routing, never access control. Regenerate the reference page and baselines.
3. `docs/adr/0063-…` and `0064-…`: one add-only pointer line each to the cloud record (cited as `cloud ADR-NNNN`).
4. Optional, only if the allow-set constant is published in spec by then: a lint warning for an `ask`-surface package skill naming a tool outside it.

## Acceptance
- The skill's eval case that describes `ask` picking skills up by surface still passes and names the allow-set; the skill reference page regenerated; changeset.
